t: This is the Grant Museum of Zoology, part of University College London. It's one of the oldest natural history collections in the UK, and the last university natural history museum left in London. Robert Edmond Grant, the British anatomist and zoologist who gives it its name, founded it in 1828 as a teaching collection, with specimens and material for dissection. Among the treasures inside are a rare quagga skeleton, thylacine specimens, dodo bones and Blaschka glass models.
